steps.title: Try one plain headless Chrome screenshot with its output

body.command:
cd /c/Dot; ls /c/Dot/*.png 2>/dev/null; P="$(cygpath -w "$TEMP")\\dp-shot-test.png"; timeout 40 "/c/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" --headless=new --user-data-dir="$(cygpath -w "$TEMP")\\dp-chrome2" --no-first-run --disable-gpu --window-size=800,600 --screenshot="$P" "data:text/html,
